what: The site's 138 live trades (src/lib/taxonomy.ts INDUSTRIES, read 2026-10-02) mapped onto UK SIC 2007 subclasses (5 digits), so the UK registers (Nomis business counts, ONS business demography, Companies House, the Gazette) can be read trade by trade.

match.exact: the code describes this trade and little else
match.shared: one official code covers this trade and others on the site; a figure from it is the whole group's and the page must say so (e.g. 96020 covers barbers, hairdressers, nail, brow and lash salons)
match.approx: the nearest code holds this trade among unrelated activities; a figure from it is a broad bracket, not the trade
match.none: no code isolates this trade; registers cannot speak for it

by: the loop, 2026-10-02, from the SIC 2007 structure (ONS); a judgement per row, argued in its note
